The '''Desargorr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desargorr]].

==Description==
Desargorr was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] world rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], pitted by [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] of ruthless [[Mining/Legends|mining]], as were the system's numerous [[Moon/Legends|moons]], [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], and [[Comet/Legends|comets]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
